replication.target_description: Final individual recognition-test accuracy for critical discussed versus non-discussed questions across the ten-country replication; repeated-measures discussion × country ANOVA, manuscript p. 18. The supplied p. 19 locator continues the same critical co-witness analysis with a meta-analysis.

n.sample_role: Participants in the critical repeated-measures ANOVA after excluding participants exposed to no co-witness details; item responses are repeated measures, countries are groups.
n.exclusions: Participants exposed to no co-witness details were excluded. Exclusions range from 1 in Canada to 13 in Malaysia; all country-specific exclusion counts and final critical-model N are not explicitly reported. Table 1 also documents replacement of two Japanese pairs for instruction failures and removal without replacement of one UK pair for projector difficulties.
n.location: Manuscript pp. 17–18, critical-question scoring and exclusions; pp. 8–10 and Table 1, recruitment/sample accounting; Table 2 p. 22
n.quote:
Participants who were not

exposed to co-witness details at all were excluded from the subsequent analyses. The number

of participants excluded on this basis ranged from a low of 1 participant in the Canadian

sample to a high of 13 participants in the Malaysian sample.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full author’s accepted manuscript (WRAP cover; manuscript pp. 1–38), with the exact replication title and matching Ito, Barzykowski, Grzesik, Gülgöz, Gürdere and coauthor list on p. 1. It is a primary empirical report, with methods, results, discussion and supplemental materials, rather than an abstract or secondary article. The replication DOI is not printed in this text; title/authors/project identity match the supplied reference independently of the cache filename. No PDF was supplied. Only n_r is assigned. The target is located by the critical-discussion outcome and analysis description, not numeric correspondence or row order. Recruitment/retained whole-study N = 486 (pp. 8–10, Table 1; also Table 2) includes participants subsequently excluded from the critical ANOVA. The final analytic participant N is not explicitly printed in the supplied text. The ANOVA degrees of freedom are printed on p. 18 but were not converted to N. No sum is used: the country counts in Table 1 are not final mutually exclusive groups for the critical analysis after its additional exclusions. The exposure count analysis and filler analysis use the whole-study sample and cannot supply the target analytic N. Unassigned effect-size, p, success and original fields remain placeholders.
